name: House Leila
description: House Leila is a private 3-bedroom holiday home for up to 6 guests in Zablaće near Šibenik, 100 m from the Adriatic Sea, with a Mediterranean garden, stone BBQ and free private parking.

items.q: How far is the beach, and how far is Šibenik?
items.a: The nearest beach in Zablaće is 100 metres from the door, about a two minute walk. Šibenik's old town is 7 km away, roughly ten minutes by car. Close enough for an afternoon in the city, far enough that the evenings stay quiet.

items.q: How many people sleep here, and is there parking?
items.a: Six, in three bedrooms, with two full bathrooms. The house is 85 m² across two floors. Parking is free: one private space on the property, plus free public spaces 50 metres away if you arrive with a second car.

items.q: Is the house good for families?
items.a: It is set up for them. The garden is fenced and private, with a shaded terrace, a stone BBQ and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach. We do not charge an extra guest fee for families of up to six.

items.q: What is nearby for food and shopping?
items.a: A market, a bakery and a few Dalmatian konobas are within a 150 metre walk, in the centre of Zablaće. The Amadria Park beaches and Aquapark Dalmatia are a few minutes by car.

items.q: Is booking here cheaper than the big platforms?
items.a: Yes. Booking direct skips the commission those platforms add, so this is the lowest rate we offer. You also deal with Hrvojka directly rather than through a messaging system.

items.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
items.a: Cancel more than 30 days before check-in and you get a full refund. Plans change, and we would much rather hear about it early.

items.q: Are there extra fees for cleaning or utilities?
items.a: No. The rate covers utilities, air conditioning, Wi-Fi and the final clean at the end of your stay. The price we quote is the price you pay.

items.q: What time can I check in and out?
items.a: Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 10:00. If you need to arrive earlier or leave later, tell us when you book and we will do whatever the cleaning schedule allows.
